title: A site for a new hamlet
Room to grow
summary: {settlement} has outgrown its land. Find a good site for a new hamlet {distance} from here: gentle ground, water near, and well clear of any other town. Stand on it, then report back.
offer: We've more folk than fields. Some of the young ones want to found a hamlet of their own. Find them a good site: flat ground, water close by, {distance} from here and clear of other towns.
complete: That sounds a fine place. The settlers will set out as soon as the weather turns.
